description: Election Commission - Declare that K. Kajenthiran as a member of the Valikamam Eest PS
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Valikamam East Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for a local authority position, including the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill a vacancy created by resignation. This falls squarely under Election-related matters as it concerns the composition of an elected local government body through established electoral procedures.
